nodes.description: Auth.vaultParameters: address of the contract holding system parameters, set in Auth constructor and read by every auth modifier.
VaultParameters.stabilityFee: mapping(address=>uint) stability fee per collateral, written by setStabilityFee.
VaultParameters.liquidationFee: mapping(address=>uint) liquidation fee per collateral, written by setLiquidationFee (bounded to 100).
VaultParameters.tokenDebtLimit: mapping(address=>uint) USDP mint limit per collateral, written by setTokenDebtLimit.
VaultParameters.canModifyVault: mapping(address=>bool) permission to modify the Vault, written only by setVaultAccess.
VaultParameters.isManager: mapping(address=>bool) privileged manager registry; granting it grants full control of the whole system.
VaultParameters.isOracleTypeEnabled: nested mapping(type=>asset=>bool) controlling allowed oracle types.
VaultParameters.vault: payable address of the Vault contract, used by the onlyVault modifier.
VaultParameters.foundation: address of the foundation, updatable by managers via setFoundation.
OracleRegistry.oracleByAsset: mapping asset address to its oracle address, written by setOracle.
OracleRegistry.oracleByType: mapping oracle type id to oracle address, written by setOracle.
WrappedToUnderlyingOracle.oracleRegistry: immutable reference to the OracleRegistry used to resolve the underlying oracle.
WrappedToUnderlyingOracle.assetToUnderlying: mapping wrapped token to its underlying token, written by setUnderlying.
Auth constructor: stores the parameters contract address into vaultParameters.
Auth modifier onlyManager: external call to vaultParameters.isManager(msg.sender) that gates all privileged setters.
Auth modifier hasVaultAccess: external call to vaultParameters.canModifyVault(msg.sender).
Auth modifier onlyVault: external call reading vaultParameters.vault() and comparing it to msg.sender.
VaultParameters constructor: validates vault and foundation, calls Auth(address(this)) (self-reference), and grants manager rights to the deployer.
setManager(address,bool): grants/revokes manager privilege; protected by onlyManager.
setFoundation(address): updates the foundation address; protected by onlyManager.
setCollateral(address,uint,uint,uint,uint[]): batch configuration of a collateral, loops over oracle types and calls the individual setters.
setVaultAccess(address,bool): grants/revokes canModifyVault permission; protected by onlyManager.
setStabilityFee(address,uint): writes stabilityFee; protected by onlyManager.
setLiquidationFee(address,uint): validates <=100 then writes liquidationFee; protected by onlyManager.
setOracleType(uint,address,bool): toggles isOracleTypeEnabled; protected by onlyManager.
setTokenDebtLimit(address,uint): writes tokenDebtLimit; protected by onlyManager.
OracleRegistry constructor: rejects zero parameters address and initializes Auth.
setOracle(address,address,uint): writes oracleByAsset and oracleByType; protected by onlyManager.
WrappedToUnderlyingOracle constructor: validates addresses and stores the immutable OracleRegistry.
setUnderlying(address,address): writes assetToUnderlying mapping; protected by onlyManager.
assetToUsd(address,uint) view: resolves underlying token and delegates to the registry-provided oracle via an external call.
msg.sender: caller used for authorization checks and for granting privileged roles.
isManager[msg.sender] = true inside the constructor: unconditional grant of full system control to whoever deploys the contract.
External call vaultParameters.isManager(msg.sender) used as the sole access-control gate.
External call vaultParameters.canModifyVault(msg.sender) used as an access-control gate.
External call vaultParameters.vault() compared against msg.sender as the onlyVault gate.
External call _oracleForUnderlying.assetToUsd(underlying, amount) to an oracle address taken from the registry without any code/contract validation.
Auth(address(this)) in the VaultParameters constructor: makes the contract its own parameter provider / self-authorized authority.
parameter who of setManager: target address whose manager status is set.
parameter permit of setManager: boolean flag granted to who.
parameter newFoundation of setFoundation: new foundation address.
parameter asset of setCollateral: collateral token address.
parameter stabilityFeeValue of setCollateral: forwarded to setStabilityFee.
parameter liquidationFeeValue of setCollateral: forwarded to setLiquidationFee.
parameter usdpLimit of setCollateral: forwarded to setTokenDebtLimit.
parameter oracles of setCollateral: array of oracle type ids iterated in the for loop.
parameter who of setVaultAccess: address receiving/loosing vault access.
parameter permit of setVaultAccess: boolean vault-access flag.
parameter asset of setStabilityFee: collateral whose fee is configured.
parameter newValue of setStabilityFee: new stability fee value.
parameter asset of setLiquidationFee: collateral whose fee is configured.
parameter newValue of setLiquidationFee: new liquidation fee value, checked <=100.
parameter _type of setOracleType: oracle type id.
parameter asset of setOracleType: collateral for which the oracle type is toggled.
parameter enabled of setOracleType: boolean control flag.
parameter asset of setTokenDebtLimit: collateral whose limit is configured.
parameter limit of setTokenDebtLimit: new USDP debt limit.
parameter asset of OracleRegistry.setOracle: collateral address.
parameter oracle of OracleRegistry.setOracle: oracle address stored in the mapping.
parameter oracleType of OracleRegistry.setOracle: oracle type id, must be non-zero.
parameter wrapped of setUnderlying: wrapped token address used as mapping key.
parameter underlying of setUnderlying: underlying token address stored for wrapped.
parameter asset of assetToUsd: wrapped token to be priced.
parameter amount of assetToUsd: amount of wrapped token to convert.
parameter _parameters of Auth constructor: address of the parameters contract.
parameter _vault of VaultParameters constructor: vault address, checked non-zero.
parameter _foundation of VaultParameters constructor: foundation address, checked non-zero.
parameter vaultParameters of OracleRegistry constructor: parameters contract address.
parameter _vaultParameters of WrappedToUnderlyingOracle constructor.
parameter _oracleRegistry of WrappedToUnderlyingOracle constructor.
local loop counter i of setCollateral used to iterate the oracles array.
local underlying address resolved from assetToUnderlying[asset] in assetToUsd.
local OracleSimple instance obtained from oracleRegistry.oracleByAsset(underlying); target of the external call.

edges.reason: Auth constructor writes the _parameters argument into the vaultParameters state variable.
Constructor parameter _parameters flows into the vaultParameters assignment.
onlyManager reads vaultParameters to perform the manager check.
Modifier performs an external call to vaultParameters.isManager(msg.sender); the whole privilege model depends on this external contract.
hasVaultAccess reads vaultParameters before the external permission check.
Modifier performs an external call to vaultParameters.canModifyVault(msg.sender) as the access-control gate.
onlyVault reads vaultParameters to compare the stored Vault address with msg.sender.
External call vaultParameters.vault() used as the onlyVault authorization check.
The result of vaultParameters.vault() is compared to msg.sender; the stored vault address determines authorization.
msg.sender is used as the key of the unconditional isManager mapping write in the constructor.
msg.sender is passed into the isManager external authorization call.
msg.sender is passed into the canModifyVault external authorization call.
msg.sender is compared with the value returned by vaultParameters.vault().
msg.sender indexes the isManager privilege mapping written during construction.
VaultParameters constructor executes the privileged isManager[msg.sender]=true statement.
VaultParameters constructor invokes Auth(address(this)), making the contract its own parameters authority.
The constructor indirectly initializes the inherited vaultParameters reference through Auth(address(this)).
Constructor parameter _vault is validated and written to the vault state variable.
Constructor parameter _foundation is validated and written to the foundation state variable.
Constructor assigns the _vault parameter into vault.
Constructor assigns the _foundation parameter into foundation.
setManager is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter who is used as the mapping key in setManager.
Parameter permit is the boolean value stored in isManager.
setManager writes the isManager privilege mapping, granting or revoking full system control.
setFoundation is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter newFoundation is validated and written to the foundation state variable.
setFoundation updates the foundation state variable.
setCollateral is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter asset flows into the internal setter calls inside setCollateral.
Parameter stabilityFeeValue is forwarded to setStabilityFee.
Parameter liquidationFeeValue is forwarded to setLiquidationFee.
Parameter usdpLimit is forwarded to setTokenDebtLimit.
Parameter array oracles is iterated by the for loop of setCollateral.
Loop counter i is incremented each iteration; unbounded array length can lead to out-of-gas from arithmetic loop cost.
setCollateral calls setStabilityFee internally.
setCollateral calls setLiquidationFee internally.
setCollateral calls setTokenDebtLimit internally.
setCollateral calls setOracleType inside the oracle loop.
Each element of the oracles array is passed as the _type argument of setOracleType.
Loop index i selects oracles[i]; arithmetic index tracking in an unbounded loop.
setVaultAccess is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter who is the key written into canModifyVault.
Parameter permit is the boolean vault-access flag written.
setVaultAccess writes the canModifyVault permission mapping.
setStabilityFee is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter asset indexes the stabilityFee mapping.
Parameter newValue is stored into stabilityFee. Note setStabilityFee lacks the range check present in setLiquidationFee.
setStabilityFee writes the stabilityFee state mapping.
setLiquidationFee is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter asset indexes the liquidationFee mapping.
Parameter newValue is bounded by require(newValue <= 100) before being stored.
setLiquidationFee writes the liquidationFee state mapping.
setOracleType is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter _type indexes the outer isOracleTypeEnabled mapping.
Parameter asset indexes the inner isOracleTypeEnabled mapping.
Parameter enabled is the boolean flag stored for the oracle type.
setOracleType writes the isOracleTypeEnabled state mapping.
setTokenDebtLimit is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter asset indexes the tokenDebtLimit mapping.
Parameter limit is stored into tokenDebtLimit.
setTokenDebtLimit writes the tokenDebtLimit state mapping.
OracleRegistry constructor parameter is validated and forwarded to Auth.
OracleRegistry constructor initializes the inherited vaultParameters reference.
OracleRegistry.setOracle is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter asset is checked non-zero and used as key in oracleByAsset.
Parameter oracle is written into both oracleByAsset and oracleByType.
Parameter oracleType is checked non-zero and indexes oracleByType.
setOracle writes the oracleByAsset mapping.
setOracle writes the oracleByType mapping.
WrappedToUnderlyingOracle constructor initializes the inherited vaultParameters reference.
Constructor parameter _vaultParameters is validated and forwarded to Auth.
Constructor parameter _oracleRegistry is validated and stored in the immutable oracleRegistry.
Constructor writes the oracleRegistry state variable.
setUnderlying is guarded by the onlyManager modifier.
Parameter wrapped is used as the key of assetToUnderlying.
Parameter underlying is stored as the value of assetToUnderlying.
setUnderlying writes the assetToUnderlying state mapping.
Parameter asset is used to look up the underlying token in assetToUsd.
Parameter amount is zero-checked and forwarded to the underlying oracle.
assetToUsd reads assetToUnderlying[asset] to resolve the underlying token.
The mapped underlying address is assigned to the local variable underlying.
assetToUsd reads the oracleRegistry state variable to resolve the oracle.
oracleRegistry.oracleByAsset(underlying) determines the address of the local _oracleForUnderlying oracle.
The resolved underlying address is the lookup key used to build _oracleForUnderlying.
The underlying address is one of the arguments of the external oracle call.
assetToUsd makes an external call into a registry-supplied oracle contract whose behaviour is not validated; the function is view so no state reentrancy is possible.
The vaultParameters state variable is the receiver of the isManager authorization call.
The vaultParameters state variable is the receiver of the canModifyVault authorization call.
The vaultParameters state variable is the receiver of the vault() authorization call.
The constructor's privileged assignment writes the isManager mapping for the deployer.

normalization_plan.reason: Argument who exists only to key the isManager write performed by setManager.
Argument permit is the boolean value directly stored by setManager.
Argument newFoundation is the value assigned to the foundation state variable by setFoundation.
Argument asset is only used to drive the internal setter calls of setCollateral.
Argument stabilityFeeValue is consumed only as input to the internal setStabilityFee call.
Argument liquidationFeeValue is consumed only as input to the internal setLiquidationFee call.
Argument usdpLimit is consumed only as input to the internal setTokenDebtLimit call.
Argument oracles is iterated by the for loop of setCollateral before being forwarded to setOracleType.
Argument who is the mapping key of the canModifyVault write performed by setVaultAccess.
Argument permit is the permission flag written by setVaultAccess.
Argument asset indexes the stabilityFee mapping in setStabilityFee.
Argument newValue is stored into stabilityFee by setStabilityFee and is not range-checked there.
Argument asset indexes the liquidationFee mapping in setLiquidationFee.
Argument newValue is range-checked and written to liquidationFee by setLiquidationFee.
Argument _type indexes the outer isOracleTypeEnabled mapping in setOracleType.
Argument asset indexes the inner isOracleTypeEnabled mapping in setOracleType.
Argument enabled is the flag written by setOracleType.
Argument asset indexes the tokenDebtLimit mapping in setTokenDebtLimit.
Argument limit is the value written by setTokenDebtLimit.
Argument asset is validated and used as mapping key by OracleRegistry.setOracle.
Argument oracle is written into oracleByAsset and oracleByType by setOracle.
Argument oracleType is validated non-zero and used as key by setOracle.
Argument wrapped is the key of the assetToUnderlying write in setUnderlying.
Argument underlying is the value stored by setUnderlying.
Argument asset is only used to resolve the underlying token inside assetToUsd.
Argument amount is zero-checked and delegated to the underlying oracle inside assetToUsd.
Argument _parameters is only used to store the vaultParameters reference in the Auth constructor.
Argument _vault is validated and assigned to the vault state variable in the constructor.
Argument _foundation is validated and assigned to the foundation state variable in the constructor.
Argument vaultParameters is validated and forwarded to Auth by the OracleRegistry constructor.
Argument _vaultParameters is validated and forwarded to Auth by the WrappedToUnderlyingOracle constructor.
Argument _oracleRegistry is validated and stored in the immutable oracleRegistry.
Local counter i exists only to drive the oracle loop of setCollateral.
Local underlying is a temporary resolved from assetToUnderlying inside assetToUsd.
Local _oracleForUnderlying exists solely as the receiver of the external assetToUsd call.
